description: This file defines the PlacementProvider class and its nested PlacementInfoResolver class, responsible for managing shape placement logic in OrchardCore, including building placement info resolvers and resolving placement rules based on context.

classes.name: PlacementProvider
classes.description: Provides shape placement resolution services, implementing IShapePlacementProvider.

classes.name: PlacementInfoResolver
classes.description: Resolves placement information for shapes based on placement rules and context.

methods.name: BuildPlacementInfoResolverAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously builds a placement info resolver based on the current shape placements.

methods.name: ResolvePlacement
methods.description: Resolves the placement info for a given shape placement context.

methods.name: CheckFilter
methods.description: Static method to check if a filter applies to a given shape placement context.

methods.name: BuildPredicate
methods.description: Builds a predicate function for shape placement filtering based on a term.
